verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a programmatic API for paper search, research reports and systematic reviews, plus an MCP server. However, nothing in the evidence describes an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at the candidate paths. Having an API is adjacent to this story, not the capability itself, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
